comment: Copperbell Mines gigas (BNpcBase 1400, the ones that drop the doors' items): 1051 HP, level 17; auto-attack 872 every 3.0 s, 677 once in three runs (a 2.7 s cast, 38 to a Duty Support member; the players' amount is that too). From Bob's Chronofoil captures of the Copperbell Mines (2026-10-25): one run with Duty Support (bd298651, visit 0.5) and two Duty Finder runs (69bea0b9, visits 0.1 and 0.3), `questkit chronofoil --battle`. `players` is the median damage to players over the three runs, `npcs` to the Duty Support members; `every` the median time between uses. Hitbox not recorded.
